description: Real-time chat system: Direct chat, pod group chat, event chat, conversation list with unread indicators, message sending/receiving with Supabase Realtime setup (falling back to polling in mock mode), block/report UI.
steps: Create src/lib/chat/context.tsx - ChatProvider managing conversations state, active conversation, messages, sending state. In mock mode, uses local state with simulated message delivery. When Supabase is connected, subscribes to Realtime channels.

Create src/lib/chat/realtime.ts - Supabase Realtime subscription helpers: subscribeToConversation, unsubscribeFromConversation, sendMessage. Gracefully handles disconnections by falling back to manual refetch. If Supabase not configured, uses mock in-memory message store.

Create src/app/(main)/chat/page.tsx - Conversation list page showing all conversations (direct, pod, event) sorted by most recent message. Each item shows: other user's avatar (or group icon for pod/event), name/title, last message preview truncated, timestamp, unread indicator dot. Include empty state for no conversations.
Create src/components/chat/conversation-list-item.tsx - Conversation list item with avatar, name, preview, time, unread dot, and conversation type indicator (direct/pod/event icons).

Create src/app/(main)/chat/[conversationId]/page.tsx - Chat room page with: header (back arrow, conversation name, members count for groups, options menu), message list (scrollable, grouped by date, auto-scroll to bottom), message input bar (text input, send button, disabled when empty), loading state, error state for unauthorized access.

Create src/components/chat/message-bubble.tsx - Message bubble component: own messages right-aligned blue, others left-aligned gray. Shows avatar for others, timestamp on tap/hover, sender name in group chats.
Create src/components/chat/message-input.tsx - Message input with text field, send button (disabled when empty or over 2000 chars), character count warning near limit.

Create src/components/chat/chat-header.tsx - Chat header with back button, conversation title, member avatars (for groups), dropdown menu with Leave Conversation, Block User (direct only), Report options.
Create src/components/chat/date-separator.tsx - Date divider between message groups (Today, Yesterday, or formatted date).
Implement conversation creation: when user clicks Chat on a match, create/find existing direct conversation and navigate to it. Store in mock data layer.
Implement pod group chat: when user joins a pod, add them to the pod's conversation. Pod chat shows all pod members.
Implement event chat: events have an associated conversation. Users who RSVP as 'going' can access event chat.
Create src/components/chat/block-report-dialog.tsx - Dialog for blocking a user or reporting a message/user with reason selection.
Implement access control: canUserAccessConversation check before rendering messages. Show 'Access Denied' page if user is not a member.

Handle edge cases: blocked users cannot start/continue direct chats (show disabled state), empty messages prevented, long messages limited to 2000 chars, realtime disconnect shows reconnection indicator, graceful fallback to message refetch.
acceptance_criteria: Conversation list shows all user's conversations sorted by recency
Direct chat allows sending and receiving messages (mock mode uses local state)
Pod group chat shows all pod members' messages
Messages display correctly: own messages right/blue, others left/gray
Send button is disabled for empty or over-limit messages
Block/Report UI is accessible from chat header menu
Unread indicator shows on conversations with new messages
Chat header shows conversation name and member count for groups
Access denied shown when user is not a conversation member
findings: Chat system implemented with full localStorage persistence for mock mode. Supabase Realtime subscription code is in place but inactive without env vars. The dialog component uses @base-ui/react primitives (not radix), so block/report dialog was built with native div overlays for simplicity and reliability. The ChatProvider is installed at root layout level (wrapping all routes). All 52 tests pass. Build produces /chat as static and /chat/[conversationId] as dynamic route.
